```{r}
#load state transition data
community_states<-readRDS(here("./output/frog_CommunityStates.rds"))
```

```{r}

# 1. Calculate State Averages
com_state_Ave <- community_states %>%
  group_by(pond, cycle, state) %>%
  summarize(
    meanDur = mean(duration),
    varDur  = sd(duration),
    freqState = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(subset(com_state_Ave), aes(x=meanDur))+geom_histogram()+scale_y_log10() +theme_bw()
ggplot(subset(com_state_Ave), aes(x=varDur))+geom_histogram()+scale_y_log10() +theme_bw()
ggplot(subset(com_state_Ave), aes(x=freqState))+geom_histogram()+scale_y_log10() +theme_bw()

#Calculate Network Averages
com_state_Network <- com_state_Ave %>%
  group_by(pond, cycle) %>%
  summarize(
    meanDurAv   = mean(meanDur),
    freqStateAv = mean(freqState),
    N=length(meanDur),
    # Calculate skewness, default to 0 if NA
    skewDur = map_dbl(list(meanDur), ~ {
      s <- skewness(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      if(is.na(s)) 0 else s
    }),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(com_state_Network, aes(x=pond, y=meanDurAv, color=cycle, size=N))+
  geom_beeswarm(cex=1.5, priority="density", alpha=0.6)+
  scale_size(range = c(1, 5)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, show.legend = FALSE, size=1)+
  labs(y="Average Node duration (days)", x="Pond community")+
  theme_bw()

ggplot(subset(com_state_Network), aes(x=meanDurAv, y=N, color=cycle))+geom_point()+theme_bw()+facet_wrap(~pond)



#  Compare Frequency to Exponential Distribution
ggplot(community_states, aes(x = duration)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 1, fill = "black") +
  # Automatically calculates and draws the exponential curve for each facet
  stat_function(
    fun = function(x, mean_dur) dexp(x, rate = 1/mean_dur),
    args = list(mean_dur = mean(community_states$duration)),
    color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~pond, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Duration Distribution vs. Exponential Curve")
```
